items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: He had a sister named Camille.

ctx.x: I don't know much about him. Was he ever, any relation to Professor Nickerson? His son. Oh, it's his son. Yeah, I told you about it.
He had a sister named Camille.
Camille. So violin that Johnny has then was to be for him.
